Lance (YC W26) builds AI agents for hotel operations that manage guest communication, sales workflows, and on-property execution end-to-end. They’re already working with leading hotel groups in the US operating 50+ hotels across major brands. Hotels still run on phone calls for everything: towels, late checkout, maintenance, parking, and directions. Every request triggers a manual workflow, someone responds, gathers details, routes the task, tracks it down, and follows up. That model breaks when teams run lean. With 65% of hotels reporting staffing shortages, the front desk becomes the bottleneck. During peak periods or after hours, hotels miss up to 40% of inbound requests because the operation does not scale. Lance fixes this by handling guest communication 24/7, qualifying and responding to sales and booking inquiries, and coordinating real on-property execution. The system collects the right details, routes work automatically, escalates when needed, and supports multiple languages. Lance integrates with hotel systems and can take action through vision-based computer-use agents, so requests are resolved faster without handoffs. Every interaction is tracked and visible so staff stays in control, while Lance Pad connects housekeeping, maintenance, and service teams in real time, replaces walkie-talkies with structured communication, and ensures every request moves from intake → action → completion. Lance is being built with deep experience across AI, engineering, and hospitality. Caleb Chan built voice and AI agent systems at Google and Salesforce. Gatik Trivedi built voice models at Knowtex and worked on prediction models at Stanford. And Gavin Brennen brings engineering and product expertise coupled with growing up around Marriott hotel operations. If you’re a hotel owner, operator, or management group looking for faster guest service, fewer front desk interruptions, and more scalable operations, book a demo at lance.live or reach out to founders@lance.live . Congrats on the launch Caleb, Gatik, and Gavin! https://lnkd.in/dj5a2FJq ...more ...more

Proud to be one of 13 founders in the first a16z Speedrun Alpha cohort. The program brought together deeply technical founders and pushed us hard on every aspect of company building. Extremely grateful to have been a part of it! At Locamage , we're building geospatial foundation models: AI that sees and understands the Earth from satellite imagery and other geospatial data. Today's Earth observation pipelines are fragmented, with models trained for single tasks on single sensors. We're taking a different approach, training foundation models that generalize across sensors, resolutions, and geospatial tasks natively. We are building the backbone for how machines interpret the planet. The applications span intelligence, climate monitoring, infrastructure mapping, and beyond. Huge thanks to Andrew Chen , Katia Ameri , Jordan Mazer , Mei En Chin , and the entire a16z speedrun team for building this program and for betting on us early. If you're working in Earth observation, Geospatial Intelligence, or Geospatial ML/Foundational Models, my DMs are open. For more details, refer to our website: locamage.com !

Introducing Biomni-Tuso, a new recipe for auto-research in biology AI model. We asked Biomni to develop a genetic perturbation prediction model and let it run for five days. It explored 500 configurations and discovered a new method that outperformed the leading methods across multiple benchmarks. We've since applied the same recipe to protein structure representation learning, enhancer–gene linking, ligand binding, and more, consistently discovering new leading models. Biomni-Tuso doesn't just tune hyperparameters. It works like an AI bio researcher for you: reading literature, thinking about orthogonal bio data sources, and testing fundamentally different modeling ideas. We believe this is where bio AI model research is headed. Instead of spending months building models by hand, researchers can describe a problem in natural language and let Biomni explore hundreds of ideas on their own data, while handling all the ML infra. Biomni-Tuso is now available as an auto-research skill (under "tusoskill") in Biomni Lab for all enterprise users. On the public platform, it is available to all users on CPU-based tasks. As we prepare for a broader rollout for GPUs, we're giving 500 GPU hours each to the first 100 Biomni Lab users to start building today.
